ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in localized circular and annular formations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discontinuous high-contrast white annular rings and solid circular blobs scattered across the dark ventral field; higher density of high-intensity pixels observed along the trailing edge of the left lobe and mid-section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch; the vertex is well-defined with an estimated interior angle of 45-50 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration characterized by irregular jagged peaks and valleys along the entire linear boundary; right lobe exhibits larger amplitude sawtooth variations compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature sweeping from the median notch toward the lateral tips, ending in sharp, tapered posterior-lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular white ring-like clusters (annular rosettes) ranging from 5 to 25 pixels in diameter, distributed across the entire visible surface area of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, thin linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally on the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe and vertical scratches near the center of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Cumulative scarring from parasitic or epibiotic colonization manifested as white circular lesions; noticeable irregular wear and minor fraying on the distal trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-density 'ring' pattern morphology where dark background pixels are encased by white circular perimeters, creating an 'eye' texture effect.
